message:
%23%23 Description

Adds two new shell scripts to the `scripts/` directory to simulate existing GitHub workflows locally.

-   `scripts/simulate-build-and-test.sh`: Simulates the `.github/workflows/build-and-test.yml` workflow.
-   `scripts/simulate-e2e-next-dev.sh`: Simulates the `.github/workflows/e2e-next-dev.yml` workflow.

These scripts enable local testing and debugging of CI/CD steps, improving development efficiency.
